title: Misleading!!
body: I hate when apps do this. Please stop with the subscriptions! I’d gladly pay $10–15 as a one-time purchase to unlock everything, but I’m not paying monthly for a budgeting app. What made this worse is that I wasn’t told upfront that a subscription was required. I went through the entire setup, created all my envelopes, and then hit a paywall. That’s incredibly frustrating and misleading. I’ve seen the CEO’s responses to other reviews, and I have to say: it does not clearly show that there are in-app purchases. That’s exactly why I was excited — I thought I had finally found a budgeting app that worked the way I wanted without a monthly subscription. Instead, it was the complete opposite. I understand this is a startup and you’re trying to grow, but it would be so much better to offer a free version with ads or give users the option to pay once to unlock the full app. Subscriptions for a budgeting tool just feel wrong. If you need more revenue, offer optional customizations like colors, fonts, or themes for an extra one-time purchase — not a monthly fee. I would’ve been fine with limited features if I could just explore the app a bit first. I was genuinely excited about Budget Bestie — it looked promising for cash stuffing — but now I’m deleting it and won’t be back. I hope you listen to feedback from other frustrated users and rethink the pricing model. I still wish your brand the best.

In the most constructive way possible, please use this feedback to adjust the timing the pay wall is presented so people can assess if your app is the right fit for them before investing a hour + into getting setup.

title: Sorry, It’s not for me.
body: I just downloaded this app. Literally today. I like the look of it, it’s cute and pink and pretty. It seems like it SHOULD be straight forward and easy. I love the concept and the idea but the actually app is buggy and the buttons stick so I have to constantly go back and re-enter figures because they were skipped. I even ended up going to the creators YouTube to find a tutorial. It wasn’t helpful. She sped past the info I needed. I can’t seem to get the app to lock in my budget dates and for the life of me I can’t seem to get the make a budget at all. I made the envelopes but “stuff your money” takes me to a place that leaves me stuck. I plug my numbers in and nothing happens. I’m disappointed in my experience but I understand the app is new and I hope it works for others in the future.

title: Refund
body: I’ve tried deleting this app and canceling within the app and I’m still getting charged. I don’t use the app anymore and hasn’t in 2 months.

title: Issues
body: With the new update, I am trying to do my new budget and I can’t type a zero. Really frustrating. Also I can’t edit the income amount I entered.

title: Stopped working
body: This app stop working for me all of a sudden. I tried deleting it and adding it back, and it still won’t work, and I’ve already paid for a yearly subscription. I’m not sure what they did with the update, but it will not work on my phone anymore, and I don’t know how to get the rest of my money back before the glitch the app was perfect. fine, help me track my finances. Let me know what I was spending the Most money on, but now I feel like it’s a complete waste of money to have to pay for a yearly subscription when my app won’t work for a year

title: New Layout
body: I love this app, but the new UI update is not it. It was much easier to navigate and more intuitive before. Now if you have a lot of envelopes, it’s very clunky. Please please please create an option to use the old layout!

title: Bugged
body: This app looks super cute and helpful but, it’s bugged to heck and back. Continue button doesn’t work at all when I’m ready to stuff my envelopes. I wish this app worked for me.

title: Inconsistent totals
body: Great system, but somehow my app totals & bank account are always different 😔 I’m sure it’s user-error, but I log daily and I’ve had to restart my entire budget so many times I’m not sure if it’s worth it

title: Monthly Payment
body: It looks like a great app, but as someone who’s trying to save money, and an app trying to help people save money, why are you charging people so much to use the app?

title: Cute but expensive
body: I really liked the layout and the thought process for it. However, the fact that they don’t tell you that you have to pay for anything until the very end of setting it up was super frustrating.

title: Keeps freezing
body: Dang app keeps freezing I had to restart my phone and it was still stuck on some even like page and would NOT go back or do anything. Super annoying. Had to delete

title: eh
body: so i loved the idea of this when i saw it on tiktok and i tried it. it’s super simple and aesthetically pleasing. i accidentally paid for a year subscription so i’ve been trying to ride that out. but i’ve ran into the issue of my app freezing up when i try to edit an envelope. i need to get rid of some old envelopes but i can’t and it’s driving me crazy. my app is updated too so idk

title: Cool app, but subscription needs to be clearer upfront.
body: The app seems really cool. I’ve been looking for ways to cash stuff digitally and the layout and aesthetics of the app are very nice. However, I wish the fact that it’s a subscription only app would have been made clearer upfront. I knew before downloading that there is a subscription involved, but I figured it would be like a “plus” option that would unlock different features. I went through all the work to make my envelopes and designate funds per ‘lope only to be hit with a paywall offering a 3 day trial and no other option besides pay or sign out. I completely understand that apps cost money to create and run and I’m all for have in app purchases if that’s what’s needed. Unfortunately I don’t really want another subscription service right now, so I’ll have to find an alternative since there’s no free option. Other than that, the concept is really cool, the layout is super user friendly and I think it’s definitely something I’ll have to return to in the future!

title: How to add money you already have?
body: Love this app so far! But not sure if there is an option to add money that you already have into your energy fund without looking like it’s extra income.

title: Cute but the pricing doesn’t make sense
body: It’s a cute app and nicely designed than most but almost $10 for a BUDGET app that doesn’t even host your money is a little crazy to think about. Most people who are budgeting are trying to cut back on things like subscriptions/ bills and manage their money better why charge that much for a budget app? I mean it’s more than a Netflix subscription.

title: Pretty good wish there was a widget
body: I love the setting and how it’s setup just with there was a widget

title: super cute - not for me
body: i wanted to love this app but unfortunately i didn’t - it asked when i wanted to budget (next paycheck) but wouldn’t let me continue without doing my paycheck immediately - it’s super cute app i just wasn’t a fan of the cash stuffing or the way it was set up at the beginning i’m sure it works for a lot of others

title: Love this app but needed changes
body: I love this app so much. I wanna give it 5 stars but some changes need to be made. I can no longer go back and include charges that occurred prior to the day I’m inputting them—sometimes I can go back 2 weeks, sometimes only 2 days, when I wanna go back and be able to add things from a month ago. Please make it so there isn’t a limit on the dates! Also, I can’t go back and edit past charges anymore. It seems like if something was done before my recent budgeting that I can no longer edit it. And my last little thing is that typing out the numbers can be a little laggy/slow to respond. Like I said, I truly adore this app and can’t see myself using anything else, but please please please look into these! It would make a world of difference. If there’s a better place to report issues/bugs instead of here, I’d love to know! Maybe that’s something else to include in the app 🫣

title: please bring back the old layout!
body: I absolutely LOVE this app and have been using it for a while now, it’s made budgeting so much easier for me and has helped me become way better with managing my money, but this new layout is awful. The old layout was perfect!! Please reconsider switching back to it!

title: Maybe a totals category?
body: This app has made it easy to stay within my budget, just wish it had a totals category of my spending so I can see how much I spent on specific envelopes monthly

title: In <3 since Day 1!
body: Few suggestions, for each envelope, can we please have a dedicated “Memo” section in the details section and (weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly) added for additional options for “Payment Schedules”? Thanks for the consideration. I plan on switching from YNAB (after six years) to this mainly because FINALLY A BUDGETING APP ALLOWS ME TO BUDGETS PAYCHECKS BIWEEKLY INSTEAD OF JUST MONTHLY.

title: Love the app
body: My only wish is that it added all the sections together to show a full total

title: couples having on different phones
body: I love this app!! It’s like someone went into my mind and created exactly what I was looking for. However, I wish my significant other could also log in on his phone to add his transactions.

title: Great app- a few bugs
body: The app has genuinely made it so much easier to budget week by week. I will say there are a few bugs that I have found to be consistent. Ie if you do not utilize your entire budget the next time you stuff your money that balance is still there (it gives you an option to 0 it out but I find that that feature doesn’t actually work.)

title: Bug to fix
body: I have run into a recent problem where I add my income and it takes away some money, and I’m not knowing where it’s going because I don’t see it stuffed in any envelope. For example, I add an income of 200 dollars it takes away 41.44 so I only have 158.56 to stuff and I just don’t understand where the 41.44 could be going and why it’s getting separated. Just wanted to write this and bring it to your attention because before this, the app was great!

title: Love love love!!
body: Absolutely love this app!! It’s really helped me keep my budget and clearly see how much money I have and where it’s all going! I just wish it could be on android because on plan on switching from iPhone sometime next year :( that’s my only issue with this app otherwise it works wonderfully!

title: Love It, Just Wish I Could Time Travel
body: I really love this app. It’s made budgeting feel so much easier and more convenient. The interface is clean, and tracking my progress has become something I actually enjoy. My only major gripe is that I can’t edit previous months, which makes it tricky to fix mistakes or adjust for late entries. If that feature gets added, this would be a perfect 5-star tool!

title: Good first budgeting app, some critiques
body: I really like the format of this app, as a first time budgeter. I love the idea of the envelopes, it just takes a bit of time to figure out at first. My only critique is that the savings envelopes are more difficult to use, as once you set your budget for the month, you can’t adjust how much you put in your savings. I add money to my savings at the end of the month, depending on how much I spend that month, so I’d love it if you can change the amount easily. It doesn’t always end up being how much I budgeted for at the beginning of the month, so it’d be nice if this amount wasn’t fixed. Otherwise, love the app so far!

title: Love the app!
body: Really good and simple app for those who don’t want the bells and whistles of other budgeting apps. Really easy to understand and use interface. Only issue I am having is I can’t delete categories - I hit the delete button and nothing happens. Would be 5 stars otherwise!

title: New to App
body: I’m fairly new to the app and really appreciate the budget focus using current cash on hand. I wish there was more flexibility on the fixed envelopes - I pay my car insurance every six months and can’t find a way to set that payment schedule :( I would be fine manually inputting the next few but I cannot figure out a way to set an envelope up unless I use one of the preset schedules

title: Worth it
body: I saw this on TikTok and it looked so easy and made budgeting look fun. My only issue is I don’t think there’s a way to go back and delete a payment (money in) once added I was just trying to test it out and now I can’t undo it ☹️

title: Question
body: Is there a free option?

title: App upgrades for couples
body: The app is great really enjoy the aesthetics but there are is one small update keeping me from purchasing and that is the option for couples who have different pay schedules (I.e. twice a month AND every two weeks). I know that sounds trivial but it would really help keep people like me on task. I hope something like this could happen because I’d love to love this app.

title: Loving this app, having small issues
body: I have been looking for an app like this for so long!! I feel like it could change my finances, for sure!! I love it but for some reason when I was setting up my account, and got to the end where it says “all set up!” It will not let me click the continue button. I have closed out the app and retired but nothing. When I first created my account and was on the main screen, it would not let me click the “Register” button either. I had to close out the app and wait about 10 minutes and try again? I am sure these are small fixes. I would LOVE to by the subscription to this but I am hesitant due to the lagging. Any Advice?

title: Love but….
body: I love the app but when I put in an expense I have to close the app and reopen it for it to show. I wish there was a way we could refresh the app instead of having to close it out and reopen it.

title: Simple
body: If you’re looking for A simple envelope style budget app app this is it. Not confusing, simple a dream for those who get overwhelmed by complicated apps

title: Best budgeting app ever
body: Love this app for biweekly budgeting. It’s easy to use and keep up with. Super bummed now that I switched to a Google phone. Please create a version for Android phones quickly so I can subscribe again!

title: Not Free
body: The app isn’t free. It walks you through setting up each envelope but a paywall blocks you from actually using the app. Leaving a 5 star review so more people will see this.

title: game changer for me!
body: I've never left a review of an app - but I love this SO MUCH. I've tried probably EVERY budget app you can think of. What I love about this is its manual and holds me accountable. I love that it's aesthetically pleasing. It's really helped me change my relationship with my finances.

title: Love it! Need a dent feature too
body: Really enjoyed the app in the past! I left it a few months ago but came back today and got the yearly subscription. Really would like a debt payoff feature!! Will continue to use 💕

title: Budget Bestie Has Changed My Life
body: I’m not even exaggerating. I have tried multiple budgeting apps and Budget Bestie is THE one for me. Absolute PERFECTION. The simplest budgeting app I’ve ever used, yet the MOST effective for me. My relationship with money has changed DRASTICALLY, MONUMENTALLY, and I’ve only been using Budget Bestie for 2 months. I already purchased the yearly subscription. I’m locked in for life. Thank you to every single person that works on this app. My stress around finances is virtually eliminated. Can’t thank y’all enough 🩷

title: Very nice
body: This app is so nice to use because when you are setting goals it’s so smooth. This app uses envelopes and the best thing is: they make you to track your own spending by not allowing you to attach any cards. So, it makes you stay on top of your toes. It also helps by allowing you to set income, expenses and transfers in between different envelopes just incase you need to put it elsewhere. I SOOO recommend this app for beginners. Although you have to pay for a subscription; $69.99 a year or $8 and change each month.

title: Best budgeting app out there!!
body: Budget Bestie is amazing. It makes budgeting so simple and easy. I don’t know if it’s worth the $75 subscription.. but it is everything I need. I’m just using this until I figure out how to use google spreadsheets because paying $80 a year for this is crazy… but I admire the hustle. It’s a solid app, but definitely look for something else long term; this is just something I’m using to start my budgeting journey.

title: I love it!
body: I’ve been using this app consistently for over 6 months now, and I LOVE IT. If you’re on the fence about downloading it, just do it. I tell everyone I know about this app, I’m obsessed with using it, I look at it every day. It is easy to use, cute graphics, it has genuinely helped me so much with budgeting and saving money. I love being able to see how much I’ve spent and how much I’ve earned, and as long as you can keep up with entering data, it works perfectly. I would say the only suggestion is I wish I could somehow add debts on there, like my credit card. And keep track of how much debt I’m paying off, etc. That would be really cool. Thanks for reading! Get this app! It saved me!

title: Exactly what I wanted
body: Very simple app. It’s exactly what I was looking for. A lot of the other apps people recommend are a lot more complicated and have functionality I don’t need. This one is so easy to use, loads up quickly when I need it, and perfect for my needs. It might not be the best for a more complex budgeting situation, but for just some basic keeping track of money and planning things, it’s the nicest app I’ve found.

title: 5 STARS - I love this app!
body: Budget Bestie has quickly become one of my most used apps of the year! The interface is super clean and aesthetically pleasing, making budgeting actually enjoyable. It’s easy to use and helps me stay on top of my paychecks, expenses, and savings goals. I love how it gives me clear visibility into where my money is going and makes it simple to plan ahead for events throughout the year. Definitely a must-have if you’re looking to stay organized and stress-free with your finances!
love it

title: Best Budgeting App However…
body: I absolutely love this app. I have never been able to budget so well and so quickly ever in my life. I love the fact that it’s on the phone, that it comes with a quick widget so you don’t always have to open the app in order to track your expenses, you can add up to three quick widgets in order to track your expenses making it super easy to use. However, to give a little bit of feedback, I will say if she ever decides to add a net worth feature, I will never use another app ever again. I’m already there with never using another app ever again, but I would like to be able to track my net worth more easily. It did take me a little while to figure out the savings envelope, but once I did everything was great. 10 out of 10 recommend if you’re into stuffing in real life, but wanting it to be more virtual and accessible to you as waiting to put in your expenses when you get home can get annoying and tedious. Doing it on the go makes it more accurate so I love this app. Yes it is 8.99 a month and 69.99 annually however I do feel that the price based on what you get is reasonable and is worth it.

title: So far, I love it 🐮💓💰
body: I’ve tried several budgeting apps and this one just makes sense to me. It’s easy, it helps me keep track my spending, and pay down debt. I really don’t mind the $8 subscription. I paid $20 a month for the EveryDollar app and YNAB is literally over $100 a year. This app is cheap and is helping me save money. It’s worth it imo. I also love the little cow. She is v cute 🐮 Good luck besties!

title: Love this app so much!
body: I love the variety of different envelope options on this app and the layout and organization of different types of envelopes (fixed or variable expenses, or savings envelopes). I also appreciate how you can set a date for reoccurring fixed expenses and optionally for savings goals. Overall I love the flexibility on this app and the easy ability to adjust transaction, balance, and goal amounts. One suggestion is I think it would be nice if there was an option to color code envelopes or just select an envelope color period so you could manually assign all envelopes with funds in a certain account a specific color to differentiate from other cash sources/accounts.

title: Helpful
body: I just got it today. I plan on using it along side of my binders as a way to track it without having to always look at the binders!! I do have a suggestion, adding a IOU payoff tracker. Kinda along the same lines as a savings envelope but the money does not get accounted for in your total balance. Example- I owe my Dad 200$ for a car payment he made for me. But this is paid directly to him every pay week so the money never sees the envelope but I still want to see how much I still owe him. Another suggestion to add a percentage calculator, that way you could type in your check amount and it would split it up via the 50/30/20 method or custom percentages.

title: AMAZING APP
body: I am loving the app, between all my side hustles and expenses it is nice to have everything in one place. Especially if you have multiple streams of income coming in at all different times. This makes me excited to save my money and put it in the cutest little virtual envelopes! 10/10 recommend!! 🤎

title: Amazing app!
body: I absolutely love this app. It’s been a struggle for me to find a budgeting app that I really enjoy. There’s often too many tabs, or something I don’t know how to work. Budget bestie is so user friendly and it does not connect to your bank account so it holds you accountable for your own spending habits. It’s been less than a month and I’m already more cautious about my spending habits and know where all of my money is going. Every penny counts. Thank you budget bestie! I’ll pay off my credit cards in no time <3

title: Love the app so far
body: It’s really cute and esthetically pleasing. After figuring out all the corks and how the app works I figured out the issue I was having with the savings envelope was just user error. This app is really really well made and the creators are incredibly friendly and helpful. I don’t mind the 8.99$ fee either personally because I’ve seen other apps that aren’t as cute and easy to use cost more and I just end up deleting them. I think in the future if there could be some sort of free option maybe with less features so, people can still use it if they don’t want to pay that’d be pretty cool. But, I know nothing about how all that works so, if it’s plausible or not I’m not sure. But, keep up the good work!

title: If you dont want to pay for the app, move on!
body: Not sure why all the negative reviews. It's a great app, easy to use, and user friendly. YNAB is a major budgeting app that people pay $14.99 for that but $8 is too much for this one? It's purpose to help you budget and be mindful about spending. I personally love it so far and if you can't shell out a bit of money that eventually leads you to saving MORE money, sounds like a personal problem. Keep up the great work being put into this!

title: Budget
body: I love the app, so much so I borrowed an iPhone to use it. But I got tired of carrying two phones. I hope one day you do venture over to android devices! But wonderful app indeed :)

title: So far so great!
body: Love it, super cute + organized

title: Change my financial game.
body: OK, small business ✔️ it’s so customizable for my specific budget, that I can make it for my paydays my specific goals in my specific lifestyle financially. It also gives you estimates of when you should be putting money into a certain budget or how much should be putting into a certain budget

title: Best Budget App I Have Ever Used!
body: I loooove this app, I’ve had it since the first day it launched and it has helped me so so so much. I have tried other budgeting apps but they don’t work since it’s connected to your bank account and automatically tracks your spending habits. As a person with ADHD those apps did nothing for me and didn’t actually help me budget and I ended up deleting after a couple of days. On the other hand having Budget Bestie keeps me in check because I have to manually put everything in myself. And although the ADHD memory isn’t the best to remind myself to update it as I spend, the app does have built in reminder settings!! I have gotten in the habit of checking my budget before every purchase which is an important factor for being successful. This app has also helped me stop overspending, especially on unnecessary things because I have to really think about the budget I set out for myself and how it would be affected by that unnecessary purchase. Overall it’s amazing and totally recommend it. Plus it’s super cute💖10/10

title: Makes my life so much easier!
body: This app has seriously been a game changer. I used to budget in my notes app, but this is so much better! It’s so easy to track and budget expenses, and the developers are always making great updates.

title: This app has saved my budgeting life
body: I have never been able to stick to a budget. Excel spreadsheets, google sheets, other spending tracking apps, cash stuffing, etc. Since I started using this app, I have been able to easily track my expenses, income, and savings goals soooo much better and easier. I cannot function without this app. Genuinely. I was accidentally logged out of my account recently. The support team was so quick to answer me and help me regain access to my account. Not only is this app easy to use and super user friendly, the support team is out of this world. I will recommend this app to every single person I ever talk to about budgeting!

title: Love!!!
body: I’ve been using this app for over a month now & I’m obsessed! I can’t wait to actually be able to see how much money I spend in different areas & help me save money!!! This is exactly what I’ve been looking for!

title: Best budget helper!
body: I love love love this app! Easy to use, and helps me so much with my budget. Month to month spreadsheets did NOT help me at all, and the electronic envelope method is awesome. Thank you for making this app!

title: FANTASTIC
body: I literally luh(love) this app so much. It really helps me visualize my dabloons(moneys). It has a very customizable interface, and it was very easy to set up and navigate. As someone who has always wanted to try “cash stuffing” but too lazy to make runs to the bank and actually stuff the cash, it’s everything I ever hoped for. I do wish the free trial was a little longer, but I have been able to decide I like it within the given 3 days. I do think $50 for the full year is a little steep, but I’ll be paying it because I love the app so much.

title: Love this app
body: This app is great I have been searching for a budgeting app that lets me budget per check and this is it. The one think I would love to see is a calendar where we can see the whole month and when certain things are due and expecting paychecks! I know this might be way in the future but a estimated paycheck feature would be great where you can enter your hours worked and it will estimate how much your going to make! Overall this app has a lot of potential and I can’t wait to see what it done to it in the future😊

title: I like it!
body: This app is much more visually straightforward and pleasing to the eye than its competitors, which makes it perfect for those with simple budgets. Very user friendly for those new adults in college/leaving college. While you have to manually log your transactions (as opposed to it connecting to your bank), I think this adds a level of accountability to the purchases you make. Competitor apps always do a poor job of categorizing transactions, anyways! You cannot physically "hold" money in the app, but the reminders to log and stuff envelopes put it a step above doing this process with pen and paper. In short, working with budget bestie requires more discipline and I think that's a good thing. Developing those skills takes time, however, it's up to you whether you're ready to pay for an app that can't ""prevent"" you from being financially irresponsible.(by holding your money or working with your bank). It's still on you to work WITH the app and follow your budget. Few bugs here and there, nothing crazy or app breaking, just be patient. I wish your team the best :)
